items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I MET HIM THROUGH BUDDY TATE.

ctx.x: (inaudible) TONE CHAMBER OR WHATEVER IT WAS.
I don't know what that was.

I REMEMBER YOU TELLING ME SOMETHING ABOUT HE ONLY LIKED A CERTAIN KIND OF BANJO, THEY GOT ALL KINDS OF BANJO PLAYERS OFFERING HIM BANJOS, BUT HE DIDN'T WANT ANYTHING BUT THIS ONE KIND OF BANJO THAT HE WAS PLAYING. I THINK IT WAS A FAIRMOUNT I'M NOT SURE.
